title.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 v4 发布：日志诊断修复 + 联机 VPN 修复 + 远程内容源容错
KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 v4 released: logging diagnostics fix + multiplayer VPN fix + remote-content source resilience

content.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5（200054）v4 更新：① 日志诊断修复，崩溃/异常排查更准；② 远程内容源容错——默认站点下线时正确处理、未配置源静默跳过、参数可经 MMKV 配置，均不影响主流程；③ 联机 VPN 修复——根因修复进程错配、建立失败时有限次自动重试，并给出明确提示「联机 VPN 建立失败，请检查系统 VPN 权限后重试」；④ 启动/下载链路核查确认——Java 在线补装（17/21/25）与 Fetcher 断点续传闭环均正常；⑤ 双 APK（主版 com.kcl.pcl + KCL CE 社区版 com.kcl.ce）同步更新、功能一致、仍可共存安装；⑥ v4 双 APK 体积均为约 88.2MB（沿用 v3 体积优化与 JRE 在线补装方案）。包名不变，可直接覆盖安装。下载见 GitHub Release。

KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 (200054) v4: ① logging-diagnostics fix for more accurate crash/exception triage; ② remote-content source resilience — a taken-default endpoint is handled correctly, unconfigured sources are skipped silently, and parameters are MMKV-configurable, none affecting the main flow; ③ multiplayer VPN fix — root-cause fixed the process mismatch, finite auto-retries on setup failure, and a clear prompt "Multiplayer VPN setup failed; please check system VPN permission and retry"; ④ startup/download path verified — online Java install (17/21/25) and the Fetcher resume-on-retry loop both confirmed working; ⑤ dual APKs (main com.kcl.pcl + KCL CE com.kcl.ce) updated in sync, feature-identical and still installable side by side; ⑥ both v4 APKs are ~88.2MB (keeping the v3 slimdown and online-JRE approach). Package names unchanged; install directly over previous versions. Download on GitHub Release.
